notes.title: Dummy Falls 1.0
notes.content:
Dummy Falls?
Dummy Falls is a game where you and your teammate are trying to overcome multiple obstacles without failing. When one of the players fails or drops out from the map, both players are teleported back to the starting point.
New Look
Everything from menus, characters, models, hats and levels has been updated
Leaderboard
Leaderboards will reset. Leaderboard now shows both players in the same column that have achieved the highscore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41724197/61dba090c4995037809228d1a526e7bb4f6ee613.png
Hats
Customize your character with different colors and hats. Hats can be unlocked via challenges. More different hats and colors will be added in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41724197/883ee3740e41e13037e4f3e1eeb96bdd80bca7bf.png
Red & Blue
Same maps from older version with few new obstacles and upgraded visual look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41724197/df38c23f4707165678f3ff4ebfe800ade3d91807.png
Climb
New map and gamemode where players are trying to climb into the finish line. If one player falls, both players are needed to start over. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41724197/dad4791d5b1baff9d84f3291d96a3f54db0f10c8.png
